title.narrative: Core contribution to Jakarta Centre for Law Enforcement Cooperation

description.narrative: Project objective: strengthen the capacity and commitment of society, state and law enforcement agencies to prevent violent extremism and uphold human rights and peace in Indonesia and the region through collaborative action. The project with JCLEC complements the Embassy's broader focus on security, good governance and PCVE that involves actors within both the Danish MFA, Ministry of Defense, Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Immigration and Integration and key interlocutors on Indonesian side. Thus, the continued support to JCLEC would comply with the whole of government approach and act as an important enhancement of Denmark's role when it comes to upholding safety, peace, tolerance and human rights in Southeast Asia,

The objective(s) of the peace and stabilization cooperation among the parties is to strengthen the capacity and commitment of society, state and law enforcement agencies to counter violent extremism, uphold human rights, peace and tolerance in Indonesia and the region through collaborative action.
